blocks.text: Preserved release-note state
The reader-facing Apple archive identifies this document as “iOS & iPadOS 17 Beta Release Notes.” This iOS overlay selects 23 substantive records from the 187-record initial state.
How this milestone differs

This is a representative baseline rather than an exhaustive conversion of all 187 records. The published selection emphasizes exact issue-ID additions and status transitions rather than every wording edit.
Platform scope
Items explicitly limited to iPad or iPadOS are excluded. iPhone-only records and shared iOS/iPadOS framework behavior are retained where Apple's text supports that scope.

changes.title: Passkeys in third-party credential providers
changes.canonicalSummary: Password-manager credential providers gained system support for saving and offering passkeys.
changes.summary: The initial notes add passkey creation and sign-in support to the credential-provider API used by password managers.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

citations.locator: Authentication Services and Passkeys — New Features; 83501802

changes.title: Authentication settings helper
changes.canonicalSummary: Authentication Services added a helper for opening the relevant Settings pages for credential providers and verification-code apps.
changes.summary: Apps can direct users to the system configuration views for Password AutoFill, passkey sign-in, and verification-code setup links.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

citations.locator: Authentication Services and Passkeys — New Features; 106351958

changes.title: Foundation grammar agreement APIs
changes.canonicalSummary: Foundation added term-of-address metadata and detached-phrase grammar agreement for localized text.
changes.summary: The first state adds APIs for honoring a person's preferred form of address and for making a detached phrase agree with another language concept.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Managed media sources
changes.canonicalSummary: Managed Media Source support arrived on iPadOS and as a preview on iOS.
changes.summary: Apple describes full support on iPadOS alongside preview availability on iOS, preserving the different maturity stated for the two platforms.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Sticker packs outside Messages
changes.canonicalSummary: Sticker-pack apps became available from the system Stickers interface in first- and third-party apps outside Messages.
changes.summary: The new Stickers interface can surface sticker packs through emoji recents or Markup in apps such as Notes and Freeform and in eligible third-party apps.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Wired 802.1X networking
changes.canonicalSummary: iPhone and iPad gained support for joining authenticated wired 802.1X networks.
changes.summary: Apple explicitly lists both iPhone and iPad among the devices that can join wired 802.1X networks in the new release.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Resumable HTTP uploads
changes.canonicalSummary: URLSession added the ability to pause and resume HTTP upload tasks when the server supports the protocol.
changes.summary: Upload tasks gained pause-and-resume behavior analogous to download tasks when used with compatible servers.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: EAP-TLS 1.3 networking
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple platforms added 802.1X authentication through EAP-TLS with TLS 1.3.
changes.summary: The new networking support adds forward secrecy, protects peer identity, and requires revocation checking as described by Apple.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: App Transport Security for external IP addresses
changes.canonicalSummary: Apps linked to the new SDK began requiring secure connections to external IP addresses by default, with address- and CIDR-level exceptions available.
changes.summary: The SDK-linked App Transport Security policy extends secure-by-default handling to external IP addresses and permits narrowly scoped exceptions.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: NewsstandKit removed
changes.canonicalSummary: The NewsstandKit framework was removed.
changes.summary: The first preserved state records the removal of the legacy NewsstandKit framework.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: HEIC rendered editing output
changes.canonicalSummary: Photos added an API for supplying rendered photo-editing output encoded as HEIC.
changes.summary: A new Photos editing-output API accepts rendered content identified as the HEIC uniform type.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Expanded subscription-group status
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit added subscription-group presentation and APIs for retrieving status across an app's subscription groups.
changes.summary: Developers can present a customer's plans within a subscription group and inspect full status information across all of an app's groups.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: StoreKit merchandising views
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit 2 added reusable SwiftUI components for presenting products, stores, and subscription groups.
changes.summary: ProductView, StoreView, and SubscriptionStoreView reduce the amount of custom interface code needed to merchandise in-app purchases.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Scrollable, selectable, and sector-based charts
changes.canonicalSummary: Swift Charts added scrolling, axis and angle selection, and SectorMark for pie and donut charts.
changes.summary: The charting framework gains scrollable axes, selection modifiers, gesture customization, and native sector marks.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: SwiftUI spring-animation defaults
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI changed its default animation to a spring and made spring animations critically damped unless bounce is requested.
changes.summary: Apps need to account for a spring-based default animation and a zero-bounce default for spring animations.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Dragging Lock Screen widgets
changes.canonicalSummary: Dragging widgets into the Lock Screen widget area could fail on both iPhone and iPad.
changes.summary: The first state explicitly identifies a Lock Screen widget-placement problem on both device families.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Assistive Access
changes.canonicalSummary: Assistive Access introduced a simplified, configurable iOS experience controlled from Accessibility settings.
changes.summary: Apple's first state describes configuration, activation, and passcode-protected exit for the alternative iOS experience.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Check In prerelease limitations
changes.canonicalSummary: Check In had early limitations involving offline sharing state, Siri announcements, lingering Live Activities, and regional availability.
changes.summary: The baseline records four Check In limitations spanning offline disclosure consistency, repeated announcements, stale session state, and availability in China.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Live Voicemail sharing
changes.canonicalSummary: Live Voicemail could not be shared in the first beta.
changes.summary: The initial Live Voicemail section identifies sharing as unavailable.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Lockdown Mode and 2G
changes.canonicalSummary: Lockdown Mode might not disable a previously selected 2G cellular option on every network.
changes.summary: Apple advises selecting a different cellular mode before enabling Lockdown Mode when the user intends to keep 2G disabled.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: MetalFX temporal scaling on iPhone 14
changes.canonicalSummary: MetalFX temporal-scaling effects could terminate unexpectedly on iPhone 14 and iPhone 14 Pro.
changes.summary: The first state limits this MetalFX stability issue to the iPhone 14 device family.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: StandBy prerelease limitations
changes.canonicalSummary: StandBy had early issues involving stale widgets, restrictions, brightness, red-mode legibility, clipping, and call alerts.
changes.summary: Apple's initial notes group several StandBy limitations affecting widgets, Screen Time behavior, display controls, gallery rendering, and incoming calls.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: iPhone photo-wallpaper orientation
changes.canonicalSummary: An iPhone Home Screen photo wallpaper could appear in the wrong orientation.
changes.summary: The wallpaper section explicitly limits this orientation defect to iPhone.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative capability, API change, removal, or platform behavior from Apple's first preserved 187-record Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: AirPlay picker population
changes.canonicalSummary: The AirPlay picker could show only the current route instead of populating the full route list.
changes.summary: Beta 2 adds a picker-population issue with reopening or relaunching as the documented workaround.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Shortcuts launch with App Intents providers
changes.canonicalSummary: Shortcuts could terminate at launch when certain apps that provide App Intents were installed.
changes.summary: The Beta 2 state newly records a Shortcuts launch failure linked to some App Intents providers.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Freeform strokes across beta versions
changes.canonicalSummary: Freeform strokes created in Beta 2 could render incorrectly on devices still running Beta 1.
changes.summary: Apple recommends moving collaborating devices to Beta 2 to avoid cross-version drawing distortion.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Home widget accessory configuration
changes.canonicalSummary: Home widgets could report no accessories or omit accessories that exposed multiple services.
changes.summary: Two Beta 2 additions cover apparently empty Home widgets and filtered multi-service accessories.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: ImageIO palette and icon rendering
changes.canonicalSummary: Some palette-based PNG images and Health or Wallet icons could render with corruption.
changes.summary: Beta 2 adds two ImageIO rendering defects, including PNG alpha-table handling and device icon corruption.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Suggested event and reminder titles
changes.canonicalSummary: Messages added on-device suggested English titles when creating events or reminders from recognized dates and times.
changes.summary: The new Beta 2 note describes machine-learning title suggestions reached from a highlighted date or time in a conversation.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Screen Time usage-detail delay
changes.canonicalSummary: Opening detail for a heavily used app, website, or category could stall Screen Time for about 25 seconds.
changes.summary: Beta 2 adds a prolonged delay when navigating from the Most Used list to a detailed usage report.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: SwiftData property observers
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple fixed model properties with willSet or didSet observers failing to transform and persist correctly.
changes.summary: Issue 109664186 moves from known in Beta 1 to resolved in the Beta 2 state.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: SwiftUI list-section spacing
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI made the listSectionSpacing modifier available inside lists.
changes.summary: Beta 2 adds direct control over section spacing within List containers.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: SwiftUI menu hover effects
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple fixed Menu being incompatible with the hoverEffect modifier.
changes.summary: The Beta 2 state adds a resolved note for combining menus with hover effects.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: NavigationSplitView controller reuse
changes.canonicalSummary: NavigationSplitView began reusing view controllers more often, improving performance while changing some hosting-controller lifecycle behavior.
changes.summary: The performance fix can reduce UIHostingController creation, so code coupled to its lifecycle messages may observe different behavior.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Dynamically enabled alert buttons
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple fixed alert buttons failing to refresh after their enabled state changed dynamically.
changes.summary: Beta 2 resolves alert actions remaining visually or functionally stale after inputs such as text fields changed.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: ScrollViewReader end-position clamping
changes.canonicalSummary: Programmatic scrolling to the end of a scroll view became clamped to the content extent instead of overscrolling.
changes.summary: The resolved behavior keeps the final offset within the scroll view's total content size.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Search presentation in scroll views
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple improved the transition when presenting or dismissing search on a scroll view.
changes.summary: The note explicitly applies the smoother searchable transition to both iOS and iPadOS.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Indirect input-event default
changes.canonicalSummary: Apps linked with the new SDK defaulted to indirect input-event support unless they explicitly disabled it.
changes.summary: Beta 2 adds an SDK-linking behavior change and documents the Info.plist key for opting out.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: 3D body pose without depth metadata
changes.canonicalSummary: Vision's 3D human-body pose request began returning results without explicitly supplied depth metadata or camera intrinsics.
changes.summary: The Beta 2 resolved note removes the prior requirement for those extra inputs in qualifying images and frames.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: SharePlay in-car QR connection
changes.canonicalSummary: Joining an in-car SharePlay session by scanning its QR code could fail.
changes.summary: The new note recommends keeping every participating device on the same beta build.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition or status transition in the 212-record Beta 2 state against the 187-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Malformed MP3 ID3 tags
changes.canonicalSummary: MP3 files with malformed ID3 metadata could fail to play.
changes.summary: The Beta 3 state adds a playback failure tied specifically to malformed ID3 tags.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: FaceTime handoff reliability
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple fixed FaceTime handoff sometimes dropping the call or transferring it without media.
changes.summary: Beta 3 adds a resolved note for call and media continuity during FaceTime handoff.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: Early FaceTime call termination on Apple TV
changes.canonicalSummary: FaceTime calls involving Apple TV and an iPhone or iPad could end during their first minute.
changes.summary: The Beta 3 state recommends restarting Apple TV and the connected iPhone or iPad.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: Editing medication shape
changes.canonicalSummary: The Health app could not change the shape assigned to an existing medication.

changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: Mail redownload for large accounts
changes.canonicalSummary: Updating to Beta 3 could cause Mail to redownload messages for accounts containing more than ten thousand messages.
changes.summary: The issue is tied to the Beta 3 upgrade boundary and high-volume mail accounts.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: Temporarily missing note content
changes.canonicalSummary: Some note content could temporarily disappear until the view was revisited or scrolled.
changes.summary: Beta 3 adds a transient Notes rendering problem with navigation or scrolling as the workaround.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: Significant Locations clearing delay in Photos
changes.canonicalSummary: Clearing Significant Locations history might take a week or longer to be reflected in Photos.
changes.summary: The privacy-state change was not immediately propagated to Photos in the Beta 3 state.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: Passcode Options during passcode changes
changes.canonicalSummary: The Passcode Options link could be missing, preventing a change from a numeric to an alphanumeric passcode.
changes.summary: Beta 3 newly documents the missing control in the passcode-change workflow.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: Skin-tone emoji in Freeform
changes.canonicalSummary: Emoji with skin-tone variants could not be inserted into Freeform canvases on iPhone or iPad.
changes.summary: The source explicitly scopes this Sticker issue to both iPad and iPhone.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: StoreKit view styling
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit views gained more control over backgrounds, icon borders, and purchase-button styles.
changes.summary: Beta 3 adds SwiftUI-facing customization for merchandising backgrounds, icon treatment, and purchase or subscription controls.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: Custom StoreKit promotional icons
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit product and store views gained initializers for supplying promotional icons across loading phases.
changes.summary: The new initializers expose loading phases as SwiftUI content so apps can customize product icon presentation.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: StoreKit type renames
changes.canonicalSummary: Several StoreKit view-style, marketing-content, and fallback-icon types were renamed during the Beta 3 SDK cycle.
changes.summary: The Beta 3 state records source-level naming changes that developers needed to account for while adopting the prerelease SDK.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: StoreKit view loading and localization fixes
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit fixed single-product loading animation, a background-thread callback, and storefront localization failures.
changes.summary: Three Beta 3 resolutions improve product loading behavior, callback threading, and localized merchandising text.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: ShazamKit API availability
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple fixed availability problems affecting managed-session state and default-library items in ShazamKit.
changes.summary: Beta 3 adds two resolved ShazamKit API availability records.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: SKAdNetwork developer postback copies
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple fixed developer postback copies failing to send or containing an incorrect fine or coarse conversion value.
changes.summary: The Beta 3 state adds a resolved record for developer-copy delivery and conversion-value integrity.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID as an exact addition in the 244-record Beta 3 state against the unchanged 212-record Beta 2 state.

changes.title: Vision camera-origin matrix

changes.title: Assistive Access calls from selected contacts

changes.title: Car keys shared from Android

changes.title: CarPlay focus indication

changes.title: CarPlay navigation and playback displays
